title: 纹人中窝：不用填充，怎么靠光影缩短中庭视觉比例
title_en: Philtrum shading: visual mid-face proportion without fillers
intro: 很多人觉得自己中庭看起来略长、或者上唇和鼻底之间平平的少了点立体折叠感，却又不想做注射填充或动刀手术。纹人中窝靠柔和明暗光影修饰视觉比例，适合与否先看面部协调度。
intro_en: When the area between nose and upper lip feels slightly long or flat, some people look for visual framing without injections or surgery. Philtrum shading uses subtle light-and-shadow contrast to create perceived depth, always tailored after checking overall facial balance.

sections.title: 什么是纹人中窝：只做表浅光影视觉修饰，不是填充或手术
sections.title_en: What philtrum shading is: localised tonal shadow without filler or surgery
sections.description: 纹人中窝属于局部面部光影视觉修饰项目，采用极轻柔的雾面明暗过渡方式，在鼻小柱下方到上唇峰之间的人中凹陷位置做出自然的深浅明暗层次，从而在视觉上提升中面部立体折叠度、缩短人中在正面视距里显得空长的观感。它完全不涉及手术、不注射填充，也不改变实际骨骼或软组织结构。
sections.description_en: Philtrum shading places ultra-soft tonal transition across the natural dip below the nasal base down toward the Cupid’s bow. By adding gentle contrast rather than sharp outlines, it creates subtle three-dimensional visual depth without fillers, surgery or physical changes to tissue or bone.

sections.title: 常与「扩唇 / 唇形调整」协同评估，视觉呼应更自然
sections.description: 单独靠人中凹陷处一点淡淡光影，适合本身唇峰清晰、只是人中沟偏平的人群；如果你同时存在上唇略薄、唇峰轮廓偏平或者人中视觉长度感更明显的情况，面诊时常常把纹人中窝与扩唇（唇形调整）放在一起看：上唇峰微调一点视觉弧度、配合鼻底人中窝的柔和过渡，往往比单拉长人中阴影看起来更自然，不显像涂了一层阴影粉。
sections.description_en: Philtrum shading works well on its own when the Cupid’s bow is already crisp and only mid-lip depth feels flat. When paired with a subtle upper-lip contour lift via lip-contour refinement, the combined visual transition between upper lip peak and shadow looks far cleaner than darkening the groove alone.

sections.title: 为什么必须极度克制：素颜自然光下不显脏才是关键
sections.title_en: Why restraint matters: avoiding a smudged look in daylight
sections.description: 很多人担心纹人中窝素颜出门会不会像嘴上方粘了一块灰印子。关键就在于色素选调与边缘羽化度——一定要结合你本身的肤色冷暖和底妆习惯配出贴合皮肤本影的低饱和浅调，并且只顺着本来生理凹陷最深处一点点渐隐出来，切忌为了追求对比度画成一条生硬黑灰印；如果本身人中本来就很短、或上唇偏厚外翻，面诊时会直接说明并不建议勉强做。
sections.description_en: The main risk in daylight is a muddy smudge under the nose. Restraint in saturation—blended to match natural skin shadow rather than cool grey—and soft feathered edges keep it subtle bare-faced. Clients with naturally short philtrums or full upper lips are advised against forcing unnecessary shading.

sections.title: 面诊试画、护理要求与一年内免费补色
sections.title_en: Consultation trial, aftercare notes and one-year touch-up
sections.description: 在描眉画目，纹人中窝同样坚持乐乐老师本人一对一先设计试画（免费面诊约30–45分钟，先照镜子看光影位置和自然度再决定做不做），门店不做升单。项目涉及局部表浅操作，不承诺统一无恢复期或固定天数，具体恢复注意事项与洁面护肤边界按当次沟通为准；操作后所有项目一样包含一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Like all services at Miaomeihuamu, philtrum shading starts with a free 30–45 minute one-to-one preview with Lele and zero upselling. Because individual skin sensitivity varies, specific cleansing and healing notes are confirmed at the visit rather than promising a fixed downtime, with free touch-ups included within one year.
